findings.summary: Implementation packets authorize overlapping shared schema and quality surfaces, allowing a packet to edit a sibling slice's contracts despite the seed's non-overlap and sibling-schema restrictions.

The frozen planning Candidate contains no tracked artifact proving the required six independent issue-sync checks, managed-body/relationship agreement, or bootstrap closeout state, so acceptance and projection readiness are asserted but not verifiable from the Candidate.

residualRisks: Remote issue projections and post-merge bootstrap closeout remain unverified until maintainer-authenticated evidence is recorded.
